scope: Historical measurements; current benchmarks have simpler validation/setup. No new timing in this cleanup.
reproduction_limits: Raw times, summary, source revisions and selected metadata retained here. Diagnostic sources, lockfiles, patches, fixtures and full build logs are local-only; this committed subset is not a self-contained source/build reproduction bundle. Primus HEAD alone is insufficient to reconstruct measured binaries.

environment.build_note: Different libraries use different compilers, flags and FFT plans; see group metadata. No equal-DFR/security claim.

statistic: mean of three process means; pooled normalized-sample median; process-mean range, not confidence interval

measurement.primus: Criterion0.8.2, one CBS per b.iter, 1s warmup/3s target; ratio of total_ns/iterations per raw sample
measurement.external: 30 single-call steady_clock/Instant intervals after1s warmup; returned output remains live until after timestamp; original internal allocations included
measurement.aggregation: arithmetic mean of three process means; ranges are min/max process means, not confidence or DFR bounds
measurement.gdb: Only newly launched children; actual kernel/plan captured in validation or first warm-up. All active FFT/CBS probes disabled before samples; processes exited normally.
measurement.core: G1 core=complete (no input KS); refined core uses actual full-path scalar-KS output; Primus Fourier core unmeasured, no subtraction estimate
measurement.pbs: not measured in this frozen CMUX2 CBS matrix; later PBS requires independent complete return boundary

limits: functional implementation-cost comparisons only; no same-protocol/security/DFR equivalence
C++17 signed-left-shift UB restriction retained, GCC15.2 behavior only
finite t8 depth1 consumers; no deeper tree proof
CMUX1 failed/excluded; Primus CMUX3 unsupported; no substituted samples
author complete ownership/workspace/RSS not profiled; documented ciphertext payload only
no extrapolation to NTRU or EBS; no cross-library speedup ratio
